tier1.text: Each hepatic artery brings oxygen-rich blood from the heart to the liver. The liver's other blood supply is the hepatic portal vein, which carries nutrient-rich blood. The left and right hepatic arteries branch off the hepatic artery proper, which supplies the liver. Hepatic arteries enter the liver at the porta hepatis, the “gate to the liver.”
